tagline: A lakeside suburban district between the airport and the city centre — more affordable than central Istanbul with a growing residential community.

items.name: Küçükçekmece Gölü Sahil Kafeler
items.description: Cafés along the lake shore with views of the water. A pleasant enough local scene.

items.name: Küçükçekmece Gölü
items.description: A large lake near the airport with walking paths and waterfront cafés. Popular with local residents.

tips: Küçükçekmece is on the Marmaray — about 35 minutes from the city centre.
Primarily residential and functional. The lake is the main point of interest.
More affordable housing than areas closer to the centre.
Good transport connections to the airport and western Istanbul.
